name: Shippo
description: Let your AI handle shipping through Shippo: validate addresses, compare live rates from your carriers, buy and refund labels, track parcels, prepare customs paperwork and create scan forms. Test mode is free.
instructions:
## Shippo
This connector works with one Shippo account through the **Shippo API** (`https://api.goshippo.com`): addresses and validation, parcels, shipments with live rates from your carriers, buying labels, tracking, carrier accounts, customs declarations, label refunds and manifests (scan forms).

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Sign up at https://apps.goshippo.com/join (free) and open the API portal: https://portal.goshippo.com/api-config/api → **API Configuration → Developer keys**.
2. Click **Create new test key** (or **Create new live key**) and copy it at once; it is shown only once. Test keys start with `shippo_test_`, live keys with `shippo_live_`.
3. Paste it into `SHIPPO_API_TOKEN` and install. `shippo_list_carrier_accounts` should list Shippo's own carrier accounts (for example USPS), which are ready to use in the US.

**Test or live**: the key decides. With a test key labels are free, watermarked "SAMPLE - DO NOT MAIL", tracking numbers never update, refunds always succeed, and manifests and batches are not available. A test key sees only test data and a live key only live data. Carrier accounts you connect with your own carrier credentials work only in the mode in which they were added.

**Buying a label costs money: confirm first.** With a live key `shippo_buy_label` charges the label price (plus any insurance) to the Shippo account at once. Before calling it, state carrier, service, price and both addresses and wait for the user's yes. `shippo_request_refund` voids a label (it can no longer be used) and asks the carrier for the money back; only unused labels up to 90 days old qualify, and the refund itself takes days to weeks.

**Typical flow**
1. `shippo_create_shipment` with `address_from`, `address_to` and `parcels` (objects or saved object_ids) returns `rates[]`: each with `object_id`, `amount`, `currency`, `provider`, `servicelevel.name`, `estimated_days`.
2. Pick a rate with the user, then `shippo_buy_label` with its `object_id`. The answer has `tracking_number`, `tracking_url_provider` and `label_url` (a signed link to the PDF that expires; read the label again with `shippo_get_label` for a fresh one).
3. Follow the parcel with `shippo_get_tracking` (the carrier token as Shippo names it, such as `usps`, `ups`, `fedex` or `dhl_express`; `shippo_list_carrier_accounts` shows the tokens, plus the tracking number). In test mode use carrier `shippo` with tracking number `SHIPPO_TRANSIT`, `SHIPPO_DELIVERED`, `SHIPPO_RETURNED` or `SHIPPO_FAILURE`.

**International shipments** need a customs declaration: create items with `shippo_create_customs_item` (description, quantity, net weight, value, origin country, tariff number), then `shippo_create_customs_declaration` with those items, `contents_type`, `non_delivery_option`, `certify: true` and `certify_signer`, and pass its object_id as `customs_declaration` to `shippo_create_shipment`.

**Units and formats**: dimensions and weights are strings with their units (`"length": "30", "distance_unit": "cm"`, `"weight": "1.2", "mass_unit": "kg"`). Countries are ISO 2 codes (`DE`, `US`). Dates are ISO 8601 (`2026-10-12T09:00:00Z`).

**Waiting for results**: the shipment, label, refund and manifest tools wait for the result by default (`async: false`). If Shippo answers with `status` QUEUED or WAITING, read the object again a few seconds later. A label with `status` ERROR explains why in `messages[]`.

**Address validation**: `shippo_create_address` with `validate: true` (or `shippo_validate_address` on a saved address) returns `validation_results.is_valid` and messages. With a test key, addresses outside the US are echoed back without being checked; with a live key, validating them is charged.

**API version**: no `SHIPPO-API-VERSION` header is sent, so the account's default version applies. Sending one would also change the version for later calls of the whole account.

**Rate limits** per minute: 500 creates and 4,000 reads of single objects, but only 50 list calls (10 with a test key); prefer reading single objects by id over paging through lists.

**Common errors**
- 401 `Token does not exist`: wrong or deleted key; create a new one in the API portal.
- 400: a field is missing or invalid; the body names it (for example an address that the carrier rejects).
- 422 / `status: ERROR` with `messages[]`: the carrier refused, for example an unsupported service for that route or missing customs data.
- 429: over the rate limit; wait a minute.

**Out of scope here**: batches, orders, pickups, webhooks other than tracking registration, connecting carrier accounts and the v2 address API.

SHIPPO_API_TOKEN.label: API token
SHIPPO_API_TOKEN.help: Shippo API portal → API Configuration → Developer keys → Create new test key (free) or live key. Shown only once.
SHIPPO_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the key as shown, starting with shippo_test_ or shippo_live_, without the word ShippoToken.

verifyHints.401: Shippo refused the token. Create a new key in the API portal (API Configuration → Developer keys) and paste it without the word ShippoToken.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Shippo is rate limiting this account (list calls are limited to 50 per minute, 10 with a test key). Wait a minute and try again.

prerequisites: A Shippo account (free) and an API key from the Shippo API portal. A test key costs nothing; a live key buys real labels. About 3 minutes.

tools.name: shippo_create_address
tools.description: Save an address, optionally validated. Returns the address with object_id (usable in shipments instead of the full address), is_complete and, with validate true, validation_results.is_valid and messages.

street_no.description: House number, if the carrier wants it separate (some EU carriers).

state.description: State or province code (required for US, CA and some other countries).

country.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code, e.g. "DE" or "US".

phone.description: Phone number (many carriers require it for the recipient).

is_residential.description: true for a private home, false for a business.

validate.description: true to validate the address while saving it; the answer then has validation_results.

metadata.description: Your own note, up to 100 characters.

tools.name: shippo_get_address
tools.description: Read a saved address by object_id, with its fields, completeness and any validation results.

tools.name: shippo_validate_address
tools.description: Validate a saved address and return it with validation_results (is_valid, messages with suggested corrections). With a test key, non-US addresses are not checked.

tools.name: shippo_list_addresses
tools.description: List saved addresses, newest first, with next and previous page links.

tools.name: shippo_create_parcel
tools.description: Save a parcel (dimensions and weight, or a carrier parcel template plus weight). Returns object_id, usable in shipments.

distance_unit.description: cm, in, ft, m, mm or yd.

template.description: A carrier parcel template token instead of dimensions, e.g. "USPS_FlatRateEnvelope" (see shippo_list_parcel_templates).

metadata.description: Your own note, up to 100 characters.

tools.name: shippo_get_parcel
tools.description: Read a saved parcel by object_id: dimensions, weight, units and template.

tools.name: shippo_list_parcel_templates
tools.description: List carrier parcel templates (flat rate boxes and envelopes): token, name, carrier and dimensions.

carrier.description: Only templates of this carrier, e.g. "usps", "fedex", "ups".

tools.name: shippo_create_shipment
tools.description: Create a shipment and get live rates from the account's carriers. Nothing is bought. Returns object_id, status and rates[] (object_id, amount, currency, provider, servicelevel, estimated_days, attributes such as CHEAPEST and FASTEST).

address_from.description: An address object {"name", "company", "street1", "street2", "city", "state", "zip", "country" (ISO 2), "phone", "email"} or the object_id of a saved address.

address_to.description: An address object {"name", "company", "street1", "street2", "city", "state", "zip", "country" (ISO 2), "phone", "email"} or the object_id of a saved address.

customs_declaration.description: object_id of a customs declaration, required for international shipments.

carrier_accounts.description: Only rates from these carrier account object_ids.

metadata.description: Your own note, up to 100 characters.

async.description: false (default here) waits for the result; true returns at once with status QUEUED, then read the object again.

tools.name: shippo_get_shipment
tools.description: Read a shipment with its addresses, parcels, rates and messages.

tools.name: shippo_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments, newest first, with status and addresses (Shippo keeps the last 390 days).

object_created_gte.description: Created at or after, ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. "2026-10-01T00:00:00".

object_created_lte.description: Created at or before, ISO 8601 UTC.

tools.name: shippo_list_shipment_rates
tools.description: List the rates of a shipment again (the same rates[] shippo_create_shipment returned), with paging.

tools.name: shippo_get_rate
tools.description: Read one rate: amount, currency, provider, service level, estimated days, duration terms and zone.

tools.name: shippo_buy_label
tools.description: Buy a shipping label for a rate. With a live key this charges the label price to the Shippo account immediately: confirm carrier, service, price and addresses with the user first. Returns the transaction with status, tracking_number, tracking_url_provider and label_url (expiring link to the label file).

rate.description: The object_id of the chosen rate.

label_file_type.description: PDF, PDF_4x6, PDF_4x8, PDF_A4, PDF_A5, PDF_A6, PDF_2.3x7.5, PNG, PNG_2.3x7.5 or ZPLII; the account default when omitted.

metadata.description: Your own note, e.g. an order number, up to 100 characters.

async.description: false (default here) waits for the result; true returns at once with status QUEUED, then read the object again.

tools.name: shippo_list_labels
tools.description: List purchased labels (transactions), newest first, with status, tracking number and tracking status.

object_status.description: SUCCESS, ERROR, QUEUED, WAITING, REFUNDED, REFUNDPENDING or REFUNDREJECTED.

tracking_status.description: UNKNOWN, PRE_TRANSIT, TRANSIT, DELIVERED, RETURNED or FAILURE.

rate.description: Only the label bought for this rate object_id.

object_created_gte.description: Created at or after, ISO 8601 UTC.

object_created_lte.description: Created at or before, ISO 8601 UTC.

tools.name: shippo_get_label
tools.description: Read one purchased label (transaction): status, tracking number and status, ETA, a fresh label_url and commercial invoice URL, and messages.

tools.name: shippo_get_tracking
tools.description: Read the tracking status and history of a parcel by carrier and tracking number, for labels bought anywhere. Returns tracking_status (status, details, time, location), tracking_history[] and eta.

carrier.description: Carrier token as Shippo names it, e.g. "usps", "ups", "fedex", "dhl_express" (see the carrier field of shippo_list_carrier_accounts); "shippo" for test tracking numbers.

tracking_number.description: The tracking number; with carrier "shippo": SHIPPO_PRE_TRANSIT, SHIPPO_TRANSIT, SHIPPO_DELIVERED, SHIPPO_RETURNED, SHIPPO_FAILURE or SHIPPO_UNKNOWN.

tools.name: shippo_register_tracking
tools.description: Register a tracking number for status updates, which Shippo then sends to the account's "track updated" webhook (set up in the Shippo dashboard). Returns the current tracking status.

metadata.description: Your own note, up to 100 characters, sent back with each update.

tools.name: shippo_list_carrier_accounts
tools.description: List the carrier accounts usable for rates and labels: object_id, carrier, account_id, active, whether it is a Shippo-provided account, and optionally their service levels.

service_levels.description: true to include each account's service levels.

tools.name: shippo_get_carrier_account
tools.description: Read one carrier account by object_id: carrier, account number, active flag and parameters.

tools.name: shippo_create_customs_item
tools.description: Create a customs item (one line of a customs declaration). Returns object_id.

net_weight.description: Total net weight of these pieces, e.g. "0.4".

value_amount.description: Total value of these pieces, e.g. "25.00".

tools.name: shippo_get_customs_item
tools.description: Read a customs item by object_id: description, quantity, weight, value, origin and tariff number.

tools.name: shippo_create_customs_declaration
tools.description: Create a customs declaration for an international shipment from customs items. Pass its object_id as customs_declaration to shippo_create_shipment.

contents_type.description: DOCUMENTS, GIFT, SAMPLE, MERCHANDISE, HUMANITARIAN_DONATION, RETURN_MERCHANDISE or OTHER.

certify.description: true: the signer certifies the information is correct (required).

incoterm.description: DDP, DDU, FCA, DAP or eDAP.

tools.name: shippo_get_customs_declaration
tools.description: Read a customs declaration by object_id, with its items, contents type, incoterm and signer.

tools.name: shippo_list_customs_declarations
tools.description: List customs declarations, newest first, with contents type, items and certification details.

tools.name: shippo_request_refund
tools.description: Void a purchased label and ask for its price back. The label can no longer be used. Only unused labels up to 90 days old; the money comes back after the carrier confirms (days to weeks). Confirm with the user first. Returns the refund with status QUEUED, PENDING, SUCCESS or ERROR.

async.description: false (default here) waits for the result; true returns at once with status QUEUED, then read the object again.

tools.name: shippo_list_refunds
tools.description: List label refunds with their status (QUEUED, PENDING, SUCCESS, ERROR) and the label they belong to.

tools.name: shippo_get_refund
tools.description: Read one label refund by object_id: status, label (transaction) and dates.

tools.name: shippo_create_manifest
tools.description: Create a manifest (scan form) for a carrier pickup: one document listing the labels of one carrier account, ship date and origin address. Not available with a test key. Returns status and documents[] (URLs).

address_from.description: Origin address object_id (the same as on the labels).

transactions.description: Label (transaction) object_ids; all eligible labels of that day when omitted.

async.description: false (default here) waits for the result; true returns at once with status QUEUED, then read the object again.

tools.name: shippo_list_manifests
tools.description: List manifests (scan forms), newest first, with carrier account, ship date, status and documents.

tools.name: shippo_get_manifest
tools.description: Read one manifest (scan form) with its status, the labels on it, document URLs and errors.
